// routing: cleanUrls serves the prerendered flat files at extension-less URLs (/faq -> faq.html, /week/30/2026 -> week/30/2026.html) and matches the no-trailing-slash canonical convention. The catch-all rewrite is the SPA fallback: any path without a matching static file gets index.html so React Router can render it (e.g. NotFound, or an invalid week).
